metadata.name: Russian Translation for Mods
metadata.description:
[h1]Russian Translation for Mods[/h1] A Russian translation for popular mods, on top of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2881743468]Mod Translator[/url]: it covers what Mod Translator doesn't. Works only when the game language is Russian — with English the game and the mods stay as they are.
[h2]What is translated[/h2] [list] [*][b]Items, trinkets, cards, pills[/b] — names, pickup texts and EID descriptions (about 900 names and 2000 descriptions): Fiend Folio, IPECAC, Lost and Forgotten, Furtherance, Heaven's Call, Magic-Expanded, Flipped Runes and smaller mods; golden trinket and Mom's Box effects, birthrights, Book of Virtues wisps. [*][b]Passive Skill Trees[/b] — every node, tree names, help pages (with Russian pictures), the level bar. [*][b]Dead Sea Scrolls menus[/b] of all mods (settings, changelog headers, tips), [b]Mod Config Menu[/b] sections, [b]Encyclopedia[/b] articles (the main sections of thousands of entries). [*][b]Fiend Folio fortunes[/b] (about 6700), pop-up texts of mods, built-in mod labels, the REPENTOGON stats page. [*][b]Pictures[/b]: the official Russian pictures of the game (boss versus screen, giant book, controls on the floor) and Russian versions of mod pictures (controls of modded characters, PST help) — swapped in only with the Russian language. [/list]
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3127536138]REPENTOGON[/url] [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2881743468]Mod Translator[/url] (its Cyrillic fonts) [*]the mods you want translated — only installed ones are touched [/list]
[h2]Links[/h2] Source code: [url=https://github.com/blackhellvelz-prog/isaac-russian-translation-for-mods]GitHub[/url] More from the same set: Basement Scrapbook Menu, Dead Sea Scrolls: Unrolled, Talents for Everyone, Peat, Isaac-Style, Mod Fixes & Speedups.
Made with Universal Modder. The translated texts belong to the authors of the original mods. Author: blackhellvelz.
